name: Google BigQuery MCP Server
shortDescription: Execute analytical SQL queries, inspect enterprise datasets, schemas, partition tables, and optimize query costs.
longDescription: Query petabyte-scale datasets in Google BigQuery. Let AI assistants analyze schemas, run partitioned SQL queries, inspect table metadata, and calculate processed bytes for data analytics.
author: googlecloud-community

envVars.name: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
envVars.description: Path to GCP Service Account JSON key or ADC config.

tools.name: bigquery_run_query
tools.description: Execute a SQL query against BigQuery datasets.

tools.name: bigquery_list_tables
tools.description: List datasets and tables in a project.

tools.name: bigquery_get_schema
tools.description: Retrieve table schema fields and clustering properties.

prerequisites: Google Cloud project with BigQuery API enabled

installSteps.title: Configure Service Account
installSteps.description: Provide Service Account JSON path and GCP Project ID.
